improved_holy_strike.name: Improved Holy Strike
improved_holy_strike.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by {0} sec.

healing_light.name: Healing Light
healing_light.text: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by {0}%.

spiritual_focus.name: Spiritual Focus
spiritual_focus.text: Gives your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Light's Vigil spells a {0}% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

improved_seals.name: Improved Seals
improved_seals.text: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by {0}%.

unyielding_faith.name: Unyielding Faith
unyielding_faith.text: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by {0}%.

voice_of_truth.name: Voice of Truth
voice_of_truth.text: Grants you immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects. Lasts 6 sec.

reverence.name: Reverence
reverence.text: Allows {0}% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

purifying_power.name: Purifying Power
purifying_power.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by {0}% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by {1}%.

infusion_of_light.name: Infusion of Light
infusion_of_light.text: Your Holy Shock and Flash of Light critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light cast within {0} sec by {1} sec.

illumination.name: Illumination
illumination.text: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a {0}% chance to gain Mana equal to {1}% of the base cost of the spell.

divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
divine_favor.text: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

divine_precision.name: Divine Precision
divine_precision.text: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by {0}%.

holy_shock.name: Holy Shock
holy_shock.text: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

consecrated_ground.name: Consecrated Ground
consecrated_ground.text: Gives your Holy spells {0}% increased damage against the first {1} enemies that enter your Consecration.

holy_power.name: Holy Power
holy_power.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by {0}%, and all other spells by {1}%.

light_s_vigil.name: Light's Vigil
light_s_vigil.text: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes friendly targets to heal their party for 325 to 343, or enemy targets to suffer 175 to 189 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost. You may only have 1 Light's Vigil active per Paladin, per party.

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.text: Increases your armor value from items by {0}%.

redoubt.name: Redoubt
redoubt.text: Damaging melee attacks against you have a {0}% chance to increase your chance to block by {1}%. Lasts {2} sec or {3} blocks.

precision.name: Precision
precision.text: Improves your chance to hit by {0}%.

guardian_s_favor.name: Guardian's Favor
guardian_s_favor.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection by {0} min and increases the duration of your Blessing of Freedom by {1} sec.

improved_seal_of_fury.name: Improved Seal of Fury
improved_seal_of_fury.text: When Seal of Fury's shield is fully absorbed, restore 60 Mana, increased by 15% per level the attacker is above you, up to 45%.

improved_righteous_fury.name: Improved Righteous Fury
improved_righteous_fury.text: While Righteous Fury is active, all damage taken is reduced by {0}%.

shield_specialization.name: Shield Specialization
shield_specialization.text: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by {0}%, and gives your blocks a {1}% chance to restore {2}% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every {3} sec.

sacred_duty.name: Sacred Duty
sacred_duty.text: Increases your total Stamina by {0}% and reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, Divine Protection, and Templar's Bulwark spells by {1} sec.

swift_judgement.name: Swift Judgement
swift_judgement.text: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

one_handed_weapon_specialization.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
one_handed_weapon_specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with one-handed melee weapons by {0}%.

improved_hammer_of_justice.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
improved_hammer_of_justice.text: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by {0} sec.

templar_s_bulwark.name: Templar's Bulwark
templar_s_bulwark.text: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

reckoning.name: Reckoning
reckoning.text: Gives you a {0}% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a {1}% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.

iron_creed.name: Iron Creed
iron_creed.text: Increases the threat generated by your Holy Strike ability {0}%. While Righteous Fury is active, Holy Strike also reduces your damage taken by {1}% for {2} sec.

holy_shield.name: Holy Shield
holy_shield.text: Increases chance to block by 20% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

benediction.name: Benediction
benediction.text: Reduces the Mana cost of all instant cast spells and abilities by {0}%.

improved_judgement.name: Improved Judgement
improved_judgement.text: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement ability by {0} sec.

holy_conduit.name: Holy Conduit
holy_conduit.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Consecration, Holy Wrath, Exorcism, and Hammer of Wrath spells by {0}%.

conviction.name: Conviction
conviction.text: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by {0}%.

vindication.name: Vindication
vindication.text: Gives your damaging melee attacks a chance to reduce the target's Attack Power by {0}, and increase your Attack Power by {1}% for {2} sec.

sanctified_judgement.name: Sanctified Judgement
sanctified_judgement.text: Gives your Judgement ability a {0}% chance to return {1}% of the Mana cost of the judged seal.

seal_of_command.name: Seal of Command
seal_of_command.text:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 68 to 73 Holy damage, 137 to 145 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.

pursuit_of_justice.name: Pursuit of Justice
pursuit_of_justice.text: Increases movement speed and mounted movement speed by {0}%. This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

eye_for_an_eye.name: Eye for an Eye
eye_for_an_eye.text: All critical strikes against you cause {0}% of the damage taken to the attacker as well. The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed {1}% of the Paladin's total health.

sacred_arbiter.name: Sacred Arbiter
sacred_arbiter.text: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 10% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

crusade.name: Crusade
crusade.text: Increases all damage dealt by {0}%. Increased by an additional {1}% against Demon and Undead targets.

two_handed_weapon_specialization.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
two_handed_weapon_specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by {0}%.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.text: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by {0}% for {1} sec after landing a critical strike. Stacks up to {2} times.

repentance.name: Repentance
repentance.text: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.

champion_of_the_light.name: Champion of the Light
champion_of_the_light.text: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to {0}% of your Intellect.

instrument_of_law.name: Instrument of Law
instrument_of_law.text: Reduces the cast time of your Hammer of Wrath by {0} sec, and reduces all threat you generate by {1}% while Righteous Fury is not active.

twist_of_light.name: Twist of Light
twist_of_light.text: When you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
